BASE_URL = "{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}"
AUTH = {"Authorization": "Bearer token"}

collection_name = f"test_search_vis_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

# Create collection with index
payload = {
    "collectionName": collection_name,
    "schema": {
        "autoID": False,
        "enableDynamicField": True,
        "fields": [
            {"fieldName": "id", "dataType": "Int64", "isPrimary": True},
            {"fieldName": "vector", "dataType": "FloatVector", "elementTypeParams": {"dim": 4}}
        ]
    },
    "indexParams": [
        {"fieldName": "vector", "metricType": "COSINE", "indexType": "AUTOINDEX"}
    ]
}
r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v2/vectordb/collections/create", json=payload, headers=AUTH)
print(f"Create: {r.status_code} {r.text}")
assert r.json().get('code') == 0, f"Failed: {r.text}"
time.sleep(0.5)

# Insert 5 entities
insert_data = {
    "collectionName": collection_name,
    "data": [
        {"id": 1, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]},
        {"id": 2, "vector": [0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5]},
        {"id": 3, "vector": [0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6]},
        {"id": 4, "vector": [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7]},

    ]
}
r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v2/vectordb/entities/insert", json=insert_data, headers=AUTH)
print(f"Insert: {r.status_code} {r.text}")
assert r.json().get('code') == 0, f"Insert failed: {r.text}"
time.sleep(0.3)

# Load collection
r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v2/vectordb/collections/load", json={"collectionName": collection_name}, headers=AUTH)
print(f"Load: {r.status_code} {r.text}")
time.sleep(1)

# Get stats to verify count
r = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v2/vectordb/collections/get_stats", json={"collectionName": collection_name}, headers=AUTH)
print(f"Stats: {r.status_code} {r.text}")
stats = r.json()
row_count = stats.get('data', {}).get('rowCount', 0)
print(f"Row count: {row_count}")
if row_count < 5:
